stories.title: BCSO: Man, 59, accused of shooting at repossession truck driver in south Bexar County
stories.summary: Bexar County Sheriff's deputies arrested Roland Imming after the shooting Tuesday afternoon in the 20000 block of Silver Wings Drive Drive

stories.title: SAPD could soon start sharing more information about its cooperation, interactions with ICE in San Antonio
stories.summary: A city committee advanced a new version of a proposal to increase transparency about how SAPD works with ICE. Some community advocates said it was "watered-down."

stories.title: 'I'm just lost for words right now' | Family remembers 41-year-old woman killed in west San Antonio shooting
stories.summary: The family of 41-year-old Maggie Huizar remembers her as a loving mother and grandmother while speaking out about the abusive relationship they say led to her death.

stories.title: Police investigating murder-suicide after disturbance call in Schertz
stories.summary: On Monday, Schertz police announced they are investigating this as a murder-suicide.

stories.title: BCSO asking for help locating missing 16-year-old girl last seen on far southwest side
stories.summary: A’yalla is described as being 5-foot-7 inches tall and weighing about 170 pounds. She has brown hair and brown eyes.

stories.title: SAPD officer arrested on sexual assault charge for alleged 2019 incident, placed on administrative duty
stories.summary: In 2024, San Antonio police received a report of an allegation of sexual assault against Officer Marcus Bazan for an incident that happened in 2019.

stories.title: Man in custody after leading police officers on east-side chase in stolen truck, SAPD says
stories.summary: Police said the truck was reported stolen a few days ago.

stories.title: Life Scout turns Fiesta medal fundraiser into healing greenhouse for veterans
stories.summary: What started with a $10 Fiesta medal is now growing into a place of healing for veterans.

stories.title: How vulnerable are our power and water supply to potential cyber attacks?
stories.summary: Experts at the Billington Infrastructure Cybersecurity Summit say all systems have some type of vulnerability.

stories.title: Suspect, officers identified in fatal shooting on west side, SAPD says
stories.summary: SAPD says a man barricaded himself inside a west side home before pointing a gun at officers, prompting two SWAT officers to open fire.

stories.title: AFFIDAVIT: Former San Antonio educator accused of sexually assaulting student
stories.summary: Charlyann Silva Guerra was charged with two felonies, including sexual assault of a child and improper relationship between an educator and student.

stories.title: George Gervin Academy students bring Thanksgiving cheer to San Antonio seniors
stories.summary: Organizers said the project also encourages connections between generations through simple acts of kindness and gratitude.
